generated.details: At mid-right, beside the laptop on the tabletop, the plain charcoal craft cutting mat is a thin rectangular rubber sheet lying flat, with subtly worn edges and no numbers or lettering.

On the mat's outer-right side, the small unfinished abstract wire armature has bent silver wire loops twisted together at their junctions, with a broad wire foot resting on the mat and several free ends.
At far-right on the back tabletop, the studio task lamp has a weighted base, two hinged metal arm sections and a shallow shade aimed down toward the mat.
